{{Top|leg}}
The '''Cruelest Cut''' was one of the most notorious cantinas in [[Point Nadir]]. It was located in the [[Nest (Point Nadir)|Nest]]. It catered to thugs, assassins, fighters and mercenaries. It was owned by a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] named [[Yuelo]].<ref name="Scum and Villainy">[[Scum and Villainy (sourcebook)|''Scum and Villainy'']]</ref>

It ran gladiatorial events and live blood sports. Usually slaves were used as combatants, but there were weekly contests open to volunteers.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />
